content_units: Sales Performance Snapshot
Based on total   revenue  ,   Tech   performed best in this dataset. It also led in total units among the higher-priced categories, while   Office Supplies   was strongest on volume efficiency.
Category Performance Comparison
Category   Total Revenue   Total Units   Avg Revenue/Unit
Office Supplies   39,300   1,530   25.69
Best-performing category: Tech
- Highest total revenue:   73,400
- Highest monthly revenue in every month:   Jan 24,100  ,   Feb 22,800  ,   Mar 26,500
- Strong unit sales relative to other premium categories:   390 units
Three Manager-Friendly Charts
1) Revenue by Category
Use a   bar chart   with categories on the x-axis and total revenue on the y-axis.
- Best for answering:   Which category won overall?
- Story it tells: Tech clearly outperformed Furniture and Office Supplies in revenue.
2) Monthly Revenue Trend by Category
Use a   multi-line chart   with Month on the x-axis and Revenue on the y-axis.
- Best for answering:   How did each category trend over time?
- Story it tells: Tech dipped in February but rebounded strongly in March; Office Supplies grew steadily; Furniture was more uneven.
3) Units vs Revenue by Category
Use a   scatter plot or combo chart   comparing total units and total revenue by category.
- Best for answering:   Are we winning through volume or pricing?
- Story it tells: Office Supplies drives high volume but low revenue per unit, while Tech and Furniture generate much more revenue per sale.
Key Takeaways for Management
-   Tech is the top category overall   with   73.4k   in revenue, about   33% higher than Furniture   and   87% higher than Office Supplies  .
-   Office Supplies sold the most units   by far (  1,530 units  ) but produced the lowest revenue, indicating a low-price, high-volume model.
-   Furniture had the highest average revenue per unit   (  201.47  ), slightly above Tech, but lower unit volume limited total revenue.
-   All categories improved from February to March  , with Tech showing the strongest March finish.
-   Office Supplies was the most consistent grower  , increasing revenue every month from   12.0k → 13.2k → 14.1k  .
- If the goal is   top-line growth  , Tech is the category to prioritize; if the goal is   volume expansion  , Office Supplies is the operational workhorse.
